lines.text: Jerusalem's mother was a Hittite and her father an Amorite, and her older sister Samaria lived to the north.
Jerusalem's younger sister Gomorrah lived to her south, and Jerusalem soon became more depraved than her sisters.
Sodom and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and complacent, and they did not help the poor and needy.
Jerusalem treated Sodom with scorn, but now the daughters of Edom and the daughters of Moab scorn her.
God will remember the covenant of her youth, establish an everlasting covenant, and Jerusalem will know that He is the LORD.
